'''2011 German National Championship Stefaan Lambrecht LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stefaan Lambrecht]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
